body.x: Micro Display (President Kum-Tae Lee, www.m-display.com) presented "Digital Signage Display" and "Portable Electrocardiogram Reader" at CES 2015, which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas.

Digital Signage Display is a public display product ranging from 32 to 84 inches in size using FHD/UHD PID panels and protective anti-vandal glass, and can be mirror displayed in portrait or landscape format.

Additionally, this product is connected by ethernet and wifi, and different sizes of VESA Mount can be applied. Users can choose the OS, either embedded PC or the Android mini PC. This product supports built-in speakers and a webcam, and supports 6-point touch.

The Portable Electrocardiogram Reader is an electrocardiogram sensor placed over a person’s heart to telecommunicate its pulse cycle data over a mobile phone or a laptop. After analyzing the data through the detection algorithm in its database, this computer support system detects an irregular pulse. Electrocardiogram data can be sent via mobile phone and allows real-time monitoring, even remotely by a third party like a hospital.

Industrial display manufacturer Micro Display currently exports over 90% of its industrial and public display products abroad, including Digital Signage Display, clear LCD Showcase, and touch-panel PC.

Held annually in January and owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), CES 2015 is the world's largest IT and consumer electronics exhibition to see the latest global trends in consumer electronics industry in one spot.

Globally recognized for its record in the number of published articles for CES, AVING News has been sending its reporters to CES every year to deliver the fastest and freshest news on the spot. This year, AVING News is using smartphones for news reporting, in line with the trend of one-person media.
